luke-partnerships: Heads-up from Marie at Nitro: a supplier delay on connector harnesses may push 4 racks out ~10 days. Affects a handful of Dedicated reservations and one marketplace co-sell. Need quick prioritization.
marie-nitro: Confirmed. Affected batches C-210/C-211. We can prioritize 2 racks per week for partial shipments if you send priority IDs. Expedite fee ~7% per rack.
ash-ops: Which customers are at risk? we have acct-lumen (enterprise reserved) and acct-arcade (marketplace launch). Lumen has delivery terms.
keisha-sales: Lumen needs to be prioritized. Arcade could accept a fallback if we offer credits.
dan-eng: Short mitigations: 1) marketplace reserved VMs as stop-gap (provision ~3 days), 2) GPU-class swap to A10 (perf hit), 3) staggered activations. Cache warming required for any failover.
luke-partnerships: Marie, can you hold 2 racks pending a priority list for 8 hours?
marie-nitro: Yes. Hold for 8h with PO refs. Sending formal notice to partnerships@redwood.com in 30m.
keisha-sales: I'll contact Lumen and Arcade. Propose: Lumen expedite (cover 7% fee) or else we'll route to marketplace with 20% first-month credit for Arcade.
dan-eng: If we go marketplace fallback, engineering will add cache warmers and set allocation split 60/40. Expect 15-30% latency increase.
ash-ops: Opening incident INC-2026-1129 to track costs & customer comms.
inc-bot: Incident INC-2026-1129 created by ash-ops - "Partner harness delay impacting Dedicated activations" - priority P2.
legal-bot: Draft expedite amendment template available in legal-drive; attach before customer sign-off.
luke-partnerships: Action items: @keisha-sales customer decisions by EOD, @marie-nitro formal ETA + PO instructions, @dan-eng perf delta + cache plan, @ash-ops incident owner. Sync in partnerships tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
